intent: Believable leader and attentive crowd in the same film as the Pashtun; faithful powerful horse rear with a heavy landing.
protected: Existing creative authority; no production change in this evaluation

references.role: Rearing clip governs coupled motion; accepted Pashtun governs same-film appearance, not leader identity.320 plan is already informed by Director feedback.

requirements.criterion: Column neck, straight hind supports, frozen rider or deceleration before landing persists despite timing similarity.
Statue torso, heads snap, synchronized side shuffles or people turn attention away from rider.
Primitive garment shells, block face or slab saddle remains visibly out of film even if files and tests succeed.
Debris precedes contact, collapses, impact is weak or hoof descent floats.

pose_family.derivation: Faithful rear is a coupled shape sequence, not just matching duration or lifting front legs.
pose_family.method: Reconstruct gather, support compression, drive, apex, descent, contact and absorption as overlapping full-body poses. Compare hocks, chest, poll, foreleg folds and support before retiming.
pose_family.early_proof: Matched reference/candidate pose families at intended angle followed by continuous playback; visible mismatch rejects before Director AV queue.
pose_family.failure_condition: Column neck, straight hind supports, frozen rider or deceleration before landing persists despite timing similarity.
pose_family.reopen_when: Camera, source authority, performance, contacts or coupled assets change; previous evidence no longer covers the shot.

human_acknowledgment.derivation: An exchange must read as intentional social response, not a prop action followed by synchronized obstacles moving aside.
human_acknowledgment.method: Anchor leader eyeline and body balance to rider; derive varied but causal crowd reactions from permission, with pelvis support and limited torso yaw preserving comfortable gaze.
human_acknowledgment.early_proof: No-dialogue rough sequence: identify who acknowledges whom and why people clear the path.
human_acknowledgment.failure_condition: Statue torso, heads snap, synchronized side shuffles or people turn attention away from rider.
human_acknowledgment.reopen_when: Camera, source authority, performance, contacts or coupled assets change; previous evidence no longer covers the shot.

same_film_forms.derivation: Supporting role reduces close-up expenditure, not the requirement for credible garment, face and tack forms.
same_film_forms.method: Prove one leader and one nearest warrior at actual shot size before replication: cloth mass and edge thickness, face planes, saddle construction and contact. Texture cannot qualify cylinder clothes or slab tack.
same_film_forms.early_proof: Matched intended-framing comparison with accepted film evidence plus revealing crop; preserve separate design and technical verdicts.
same_film_forms.failure_condition: Primitive garment shells, block face or slab saddle remains visibly out of film even if files and tests succeed.
same_film_forms.reopen_when: Camera, source authority, performance, contacts or coupled assets change; previous evidence no longer covers the shot.

impact_event.derivation: The landing must convey force with contact, debris and sound sharing the same event.
impact_event.method: Trigger dirt and grounded impact after hoof contact; retain neigh and spear timing, avoid dust disappearance and screen-space attached particles.
impact_event.early_proof: Contact frames and timed event audit, then Director playback.
impact_event.failure_condition: Debris precedes contact, collapses, impact is weak or hoof descent floats.
impact_event.reopen_when: Camera, source authority, performance, contacts or coupled assets change; previous evidence no longer covers the shot.
